TRUST-07.reason: Saturn consumes only typed Gryphon control contracts and never stores a Telegram bot token, registers a provider webhook, or sends a provider-facing secret value; those trust boundaries belong to Gryphon.

INT-09.reason: Saturn exposes typed storage and drop-point operations to Gryphon but does not own the global chat command catalog, provider command menu, reply keyboard, aliases, or conversational state machine.

INT-10.reason: Saturn does not register Telegram or other external-provider webhooks and owns no provider callback activation lifecycle; its Gryphon integration is an authenticated outbound control contract.

INT-11.reason: Saturn has no external webhook ingestion queue, repository or tenant filter, provider delivery worker, or callback ping that could be mistaken for end-to-end event processing.
